---
applyTo: "packages/webpack/runtime-config-webpack-plugin/**/*"
---

Keep `RuntimeConfigWebpackPlugin`, its runtime module, and runtime-config integration fixtures in this standalone package rather than exporting or testing them through a DSL-specific webpack plugin. Keep its public options and package dependencies DSL-neutral: accept arbitrary top-level runtime configuration without naming React-specific fields or depending on `@lynx-js/react`. Apply the plugin only to a host compilation; lazy and external bundles consume the page-scoped configuration injected by the host. When the plugin is applied, merge configuration into `lynx.__runtime_configs__` in execution order; later values overwrite earlier values with the same top-level key while preserving unrelated keys and the shared object reference. Shallow-freeze the merged top-level object after assignment, and expose it as a top-level readonly value in consumer types; nested config values remain unfrozen. Keep the integration fixtures minimal and DSL-neutral: test only ordinary injection into an empty page config and overwrite-merging into an existing page config. Each fixture must establish its own initial `lynx.__runtime_configs__` state because the test environment can be shared across cases and directory renames can change execution order. Tests import the built `lib` entry, so rebuild through Turbo before interpreting fixture results.
